items.title: Lattice energy and size of the ions

source_refs.note: Lattice energy and size of the ions: a main subheading of 6.9.2 Lattice energy, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 132-132.

blocks.text: Figure 6.6 show the values of lattice energies of alkali metal halides. It is clear from the data that lattice energy decreases with the increase in the size of the cation/anion. With the increase in the size of either cations or anions, the packing of oppositely charged ions become less and less tight.

blocks.alt: Graph of lattice enthalpy / kJ mol-1 (axis from -600 to -1100, broken down to 0) against the halide ions F-, Cl-, Br-, I-, drawn as circles growing in size along the bottom. Five falling lines, one for each cation, with circles growing in size from Li+ to Cs+ at the left. Approximate printed points: Li+ -1043, -845, -801, -751; Na+ -910, -783, -732, -687; K+ -812, -710, -670, -637; Rb+ -768, -682, -644, -615; Cs+ -718, -650, -618, -593.
